correctness.rationale: PASS: Under the specified normalized Gaussian measure, angular complex Hermite basis Φ0,Φ1,Φk diagonalizes any radial multiplier. Independent factorial gamma-integral evaluation gives exact eigenvalue polynomials L0=u^3, L1=u²(3u²−4u+2), Lk=u^(k−1)[C(k,2)(1−u)^4+2ku²(1−u)²+u^4], u=(1+τ)^−1. The exact identity L_{k+1}−Lk=−u^(k+3)(1−u)Qk((1−u)/u) with Q2=(r²−r+1)²+r²>0 and Qk−Q2=(k−2)r²[(k+1)r²/2−r+2]>0 eliminates all k>=3 for every real τ>0. Factorizations L1−L0=u²(u−1)(3u−2) and L2−L1=u(u−1)(2u−1)(3u²−3u+1) establish only two simple crossings and the full norm eigenspaces. τ=0 is expressly excluded because identity makes all modes tie. Fresh independent symbolic gamma-integral calculation checked 15 indices, differences through k14 and both crossing identities; the universal ordering is algebraic proof, not extrapolation.

evidence: The result is for the third true-polyanalytic level only, not a general theorem on every Landau level.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General Toeplitz operator theory guarantees diagonalization by angular harmonics for radial symbols, but it does not establish the exact sign of all consecutive differences; the positive quartic Qk and precise crossing values add the needed global inequality.

final_claim: In the third true-polyanalytic Fock space, Gaussian radial Toeplitz compression by e^{-τ|z|²} has exactly two transverse mode transitions: top k=0 at 0<τ<1/2, k=1 at 1/2<τ<1, k=2 at τ>1, with exactly two-dimensional top eigenspaces at τ=1/2 and 1; all k>=3 are strictly suboptimal.
limitations: A differently titled special case of Gaussian radial Toeplitz eigenvalue ordering could reproduce both exact crossings.
Spectral normalization and the exclusion of τ=0 are essential to the sharp classification.
